// diagnostic E0805

Jet.YieldOutsideStream

`yield` used outside a function declared `-> Stream<T>`

What

`yield` used outside a function declared `-> Stream<T>`

Why

`yield` hands a value to a `Stream<T>` consumer, so only a function declared `-> Stream<T>` can use it

Fix

Declare `-> Stream<T>` on this function before using `yield`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.YieldOutsideStream: Tests/UI/yield_outside_generator.stderr.

Error: Jet.YieldOutsideStream: `yield` outside a generator
  --> Tests/UI/yield_outside_generator.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     yield 5
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `yield` hands a value to a `Stream<T>` consumer — only a function declared `-> Stream<T>` may use it
 Fix: Declare `-> Stream<T>` on this function, or remove the `yield`
